title_zh: RealVDeblur：一步扩散实现通用真实视频去模糊
title_en: RealVDeblur: One-Step Diffusion for Generalizable Real-World Video Deblurring
summary_zh: 真实视频去模糊因运动模式多样、退化复杂及真实训练数据匮乏而具挑战性。RealVDeblur提出了一个高效生成框架，通过基于3D高斯点云和高帧率视频的大规模物理真实模糊合成，提供逼真训练数据覆盖摄像机及物体运动模糊。采用视频扩散先验，禁用VAE的时间压缩并采用逐帧编码以适应帧间模糊变化。为长视频实用，设计了一步生成器和训练免费时序窗口掩码，实现稳定推理与恒定内存。实验证明在多个真实基准上具备优异视觉质量、语义一致性及时间连贯性，并提升三维重建对强模糊视频的鲁棒性。
summary_en: Real-world video deblurring is challenging due to diverse motion patterns, complex degradations, and limited realistic training data. RealVDeblur introduces an efficient generative framework leveraging large-scale physically-grounded blur synthesis from 3D Gaussian Splatting assets and high-frame-rate videos to cover camera and object motion blur. It employs a video diffusion prior with disabled temporal compression in VAE and frame-wise encoding to handle frame-dependent blur variations. For long videos, a multi-step diffusion process is distilled into an efficient one-step generator, complemented by a training-free Temporal Window Mask for stable inference with constant memory. Extensive tests on diverse datasets show strong perceptual quality, semantic fidelity, temporal consistency, and improved robustness in 3D reconstruction under severe motion blur.
why_it_matters_zh: 该研究通过物理真实的模糊合成技术和创新的视频扩散模型设计，有效提升了视频去模糊的泛化能力和实用性，进一步推动了移动影像和3D重建等下游任务的质量与鲁棒性，具有重要的应用价值和研究意义。
why_it_matters_en: This work enhances video deblurring generalization and practicality via physically grounded blur synthesis and novel video diffusion modeling, significantly benefiting downstream applications like mobile imaging and 3D reconstruction by improving quality and robustness under real-world conditions.

title_zh: Axolotl3D：统一的忠实三维形状补全框架
title_en: Axolotl3D: a Unified Framework for Faithful 3D Shape Completion
summary_zh: 最新的三维生成模型利用大规模先验和扩散架构，从单张图像生成高质量几何形状，但通常假设视野完整且仅用单视角输入，限制了在多视角、遮挡或编辑等场景的应用。Axolotl3D提出了一种多模态且具备遮挡感知的三维生成模型，联合条件输入包括图像、可见性掩码、相机参数和部分点云。部分点云作为几何锚点促进准确的形状补全，而相机参数确保多视角在共享三维坐标系下的一致对齐。该模型通过统一训练策略，从大规模三维数据合成多样化条件，实现了跨模态稳健推理。在Toys4K和OmniObject3D数据集上，Axolotl3D在干净和遮挡条件下均取得了最先进的表现，并在实际重建与几何一致编辑中表现出色。
summary_en: Recent 3D generative models leverage large-scale priors and diffusion architectures to produce high-quality geometry from a single image, but typically assume complete visibility and single-view input, limiting their use in multi-view, occlusion, or editing scenarios. Axolotl3D is a multi-modal, occlusion-aware 3D generation model that jointly conditions on images, visibility masks, camera parameters, and partial point clouds. The point cloud acts as a geometric anchor for faithful shape completion, and camera parameters ensure consistent multi-view alignment in a shared 3D coordinate system. A unified training strategy synthesizes diverse conditioning regimes from large-scale 3D data, enabling robust cross-modal reasoning. Experiments on Toys4K and OmniObject3D show state-of-the-art performance under clean and occluded conditions, as well as strong results in real-world reconstruction and geometry-consistent editing.
why_it_matters_zh: Axolotl3D解决了以往单视角和完全可见假设的限制，提出融合多种条件信号的统一三维形状补全框架，提升了模型在复杂遮挡和多视角场景的适应性和精准度。该技术推动了计算机视觉与图形领域多模态三维重建和编辑的进步。
why_it_matters_en: Axolotl3D addresses limitations of prior models that rely on single-view and complete visibility assumptions by introducing a unified 3D shape completion framework conditioning on diverse signals. This enhances adaptability and accuracy in complex occluded and multi-view settings, advancing multimodal 3D reconstruction and editing in computer vision and graphics.

title_zh: 参数化CAD的自监督学习中的掩码拓扑建模
title_en: Masked Topology Modeling for Self-Supervised Learning on Parametric CAD
summary_zh: 计算机辅助设计（CAD）无处不在，几乎所有现代物体都是用可编辑的CAD工具设计的。然而，由于原生可编辑和参数化格式的CAD数据集匮乏（尤其是边界表示B-Rep），开发数据高效的方法变得非常重要。本文提出了一种新的自监督预训练任务——掩码拓扑建模（MTM），利用B-Rep特有的面邻接图结构，要求编码器重建该结构。MTM通过掩盖部分边并训练一个小型头部从编码器处理后的面特征预测每条掩盖边的凸性和曲线类型。结合MoCo风格的动量队列对比学习、基于B-Rep的增强、BFS连通面区域掩码重建目标，在ABC数据集和新生成数据集上预训练，展示了多项基准测试中的强劲表现。
summary_en: Computer aided design (CAD) is pervasive, with most modern objects designed using editable CAD tools. Due to the scarcity of CAD datasets in their editable, parametric boundary representation (B-Rep) format, efficient data methods are needed. This work introduces Masked Topology Modeling (MTM), a self-supervised pretraining task leveraging the face-adjacency graph unique to B-Reps, where the encoder reconstructs masked edges by predicting their convexity and curve type from face features. MTM is combined with MoCo-style momentum-queue contrastive learning over B-rep-aware augmentations, BFS-connected face-region masked reconstruction, and pretraining on the ABC and a new procedural dataset, achieving strong benchmark results.
why_it_matters_zh: 本文提出的新方法利用了B-Rep特有的拓扑结构，结合多种自监督技术和丰富的数据集，大幅提升了预训练对CAD模型理解的能力，解决了数据匮乏问题，推动了CAD领域的深度学习应用。
why_it_matters_en: The proposed method exploits the unique B-Rep topology alongside multiple self-supervised learning strategies and diverse datasets to significantly enhance pretrained model understanding for CAD data. This addresses dataset scarcity and advances deep learning applications in CAD.

title_zh: ODeform：利用神经常微分方程学习连续4D形变运动
title_en: ODeform: Learning Continuous 4D Motion for Shape Deformation with Neural ODEs
summary_zh: 连续物体形变的建模对于计算机视觉和机器人等领域非常重要。现有方法多基于离散时间步长或计算复杂，难以实时应用。本文提出ODeform，将神经常微分方程扩展至3D空间中形变物体的连续4D动力学，将3D点云和物理条件映射到统一潜空间，通过求解微分方程模拟连续形变流，实现高效且准确的运动预测，并成功应用于新形状和物理参数的实物3D数据。代码和数据将公开。
summary_en: Modeling continuous object deformation is vital in computer vision and robotics. Existing methods often rely on discrete time steps or are computationally heavy for real-time use. ODeform extends Neural ODEs to continuous 4D dynamics of deformable 3D objects, transforming point clouds and physical conditions into a unified latent space. By solving ODEs, it models continuous deformation flows efficiently and predicts motion more accurately on unseen physical setups, also transferring well to new 3D shapes. The code and data will be released publicly.
why_it_matters_zh: ODeform突破了离散时间步长限制，实现了连续、高效的形变动态建模，提升了运动预测能力，并具备更好泛化性和实际应用潜力。
why_it_matters_en: ODeform overcomes limitations of discrete time steps by enabling continuous and efficient deformation dynamics modeling, improving motion prediction accuracy and generalization, with promising practical applications.
